scope: Aggregate eligibility rule only. It contains no source rows, identifiers, source locators, re-identification data, or protected paths.

eligibility_rule.season_attributed_undated: A blank source injury date in the checksum-bound 2025-26 adapted successor is included in non-monthly injury totals with date_injured null. No date is fabricated.
eligibility_rule.source_date_within_window: A parseable source date within the registered reporting window is included.
eligibility_rule.source_date_unparseable: A nonblank source date that is not parseable remains review_required and is excluded from the reporting cohort.
eligibility_rule.source_date_outside_window: A parseable source date outside the registered reporting window remains review_required and is excluded from the reporting cohort.
eligibility_rule.explicit_source_exclusion: Only a non-placeholder explicit source exclusion produces a checksum-bound analysis audit exclusion using the seeded reason code explicit_source_exclusion.
eligibility_rule.duplicate_rule: Unknown identities and insufficient signatures are never duplicate evidence. Candidate duplicate signatures remain included_pending_protocol and audit-visible. V12 has zero approved duplicate-copy exclusions.

compatibility.year1: 2024-25 processing paths, reporting views, releases, payloads and readers remain unchanged.
compatibility.year2: The bridge applies only to the registered 2025-26 V6 tuple and only after the protected successor receives separate exact checksum-bound approval.
